svg.aria-label: Runtime view of Dependinator: a parser (Roslyn for C#, the Bicep compiler for Bicep, or a pre-parsed demo file) turns source into a flat list of items; across the IParserService RPC boundary ModelService and StructureService build the model of nodes, links and lines, which is cached in IndexedDB and optionally synced; the layout engine, RepLineService and SvgService turn it into cached SVG tiles on the canvas; the explorer, cycles, rules, path finder, problem indicator, search and undoable commands work on the same model.
